pipeline.title: FDA launches pilot program to speed up sluggish phase 1 trials
pipeline.summary: After teasing a new initiative to speed up early-stage clinical trials over the summer, the FDA today opened a pilot program for an expedited investigational new drug (IND) application process that the agency hopes will put U.S. phase 1 trials on par with those in China and Austr

pipeline.title: Connect's Dupixent rival flunks phase 2 asthma trial, but biotech sees reasons for hope
pipeline.summary: Connect Biopharma’s hopes of dethroning Dupixent took a knock as its IL-4/IL-13 blocker missed the primary endpoint of a phase 2 asthma study.

pipeline.title: GSK doubles down on Chimagen with $750M multiple myeloma wager
pipeline.summary: GSK has bet up to $750 million on a Chimagen Biosciences trispecific T-cell engager, positioning the Big Pharma to start phase 1 development of the multiple myeloma drug candidate next year. The deal comes two years after GSK paid China’s Chimagen $300 million upfront for a trisp

pipeline.title: J&J’s Contineum-partnered depression drug flunks another phase 2 test
pipeline.summary: A phase 2 trial of Johnson & Johnson’s JNJ-5120 has missed its primary endpoint, denting the prospects of the Contineum Therapeutics-partnered depression drug candidate.

pipeline.title: Axoltis misses the mark in phase 2 ALS study, but will persevere with the synthetic peptide
pipeline.summary: Axoltis Pharma's phase 2 trial for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis may have missed its primary endpoint, but the French biotech has pointed to secondary endpoints to justify persevering with the synthetic peptide.

pipeline.title: Scholar Rock scores long-awaited FDA approval, the first for muscle loss in SMA
pipeline.summary: The injectable monoclonal antibody is the first to treat muscle atrophy in patients with SMA, according to the FDA.

pipeline.title: Corbus posts phase 1 obesity data for drug mechanism that defeated Novo, Sanofi
pipeline.summary: Corbus Pharmaceuticals’ phase 1b obesity trial has generated evidence that its CB1 inverse agonist may be less prone to the neuropsychiatric side effects that affected Novo Nordisk and Sanofi. The biotech plans to enter phase 2.

pipeline.title: Electra aims for $342M IPO to power inflammatory drug’s push through phase 3
pipeline.summary: Electra Therapeutics is hoping to raise up to $341.9 million from an IPO in order to power the clinical development of its inflammatory disorder drug, ipsoprubart.

pipeline.title: Roche, MediLink notch phase 3 lung cancer win but trail GSK on cross-trial survival
pipeline.summary: MediLink has reported phase 3 results on a Roche-partnered antibody-drug conjugate. The small-cell lung cancer trial hit its primary endpoint, although the B7-H3-directed ADC’s median overall survival fell short of the bar set by GSK’s rival asset.

pipeline.title: GSK prepares frontline FDA bid for Jideytro, its first lung cancer drug
pipeline.summary: GSK is advancing its inaugural lung cancer asset, Jideytro, toward a landmark first-line FDA approval, aided by an unprecedented complete response rate.

pipeline.title: Merck, Gilead’s failed Trodelvy lung cancer trial shows better China results
pipeline.summary: Newly revealed global phase 3 data from Merck and Gilead’s failed Trodelvy first-line non-small cell lung cancer trial could reignite the question around translating Chinese data to the West.

pipeline.title: Definium LSD drug goes 3 for 3 with another pivotal anxiety trial win
pipeline.summary: Definium Therapeutics has scored a third straight phase 3 win for its LSD formula, with the psychedelic significantly alleviating anxiety symptoms and setting up an FDA filing next year.

pipeline.title: Increased deaths shadow AstraZeneca, Daiichi’s Enhertu first-line lung cancer data
pipeline.summary: A preliminary 15% higher death risk in a phase 3 trial threatens to thwart AstraZeneca and Daiichi Sankyo’s bid to establish their star ADC Enhertu as a first-line treatment for patients with HER2-mutant non-small cell lung cancer.

pipeline.title: Akeso, Summit’s ivonescimab tops Keytruda in lung cancer survival, with strong data in PD-L1-high patients
pipeline.summary: Akeso and Summit’s ivonescimab reduced the risk of death by 27% compared with Keytruda in the phase 3 Harmoni-2 trial in first-line, PD-L1-positive non-small cell lung cancer, with particularly strong data in the PD-L1-high group.

pipeline.title: BioMarin drops Voxzogo development for Noonan syndrome as treatment landscape shifts
pipeline.summary: The rare disease biotech announced that it would discontinue efforts to develop Voxzogo for children with Noonan syndrome, a genetic growth disorder that can affect height, facial features and the heart.

pipeline.title: WCLC ‘26: A new ‘ADC era,’ China questions and AstraZeneca’s spotlight
pipeline.summary: The year’s biggest meeting on lung cancer research featured data suggesting a new treatment standard for an aggressive tumor as well as debate about the reliability of results from China-run studies.

pipeline.title: FDA launches pilot program to speed up early US drug research
pipeline.summary: First teased in June and formally announced Tuesday as part of “Operation Trialblazer,” the program will partner drugmakers with research institutions to more quickly bring medicines into human testing.

pipeline.title: Sanofi strikes Cheplapharm deal to divest 20 older medicines as CEO pushes for innovation
pipeline.summary: In a deal that allows Sanofi to shed assets wrapped up in mature products, German drugmaker Cheplapharm will take over 20 medicines and three manufacturing sites from Sanofi. In exchange, Sanofi is picking up a 26.4% stake in the company.

pipeline.title: AbbVie chips in for neurology advocacy through PGA Tour birdie campaign
pipeline.summary: AbbVie has partnered with the PGA Tour and the 2026 Presidents Cup, teeing up the “Birdies for Brain Health” initiative to funnel cash to six patient advocacy organizations.

pipeline.title: Mayo Clinic teams with Thermo Fisher to form biomedical data group Precure
pipeline.summary: The Mayo Clinic has partnered with Thermo Fisher Scientific to launch a new group focused on reaping large-scale data that could lead to the understanding and development of new treatments, devices and diagnostics.

pipeline.title: Lilly pledges up to $237M per program in CNS genetic med collab with Canadian biotech
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly’s ongoing attempt to strengthen its genetic medicine offering has seen the company pledge up to $237 million in biobucks per program as part of a collaboration with QurCan Therapeutics.

pipeline.title: FDA approves first radioligand equivalent, Curium’s copycat of Novartis’ Lutathera
pipeline.summary: The FDA has approved the industry’s first radioligand equivalent in Curium’s lutetium Lu 177 dotatate injection, Bexlutry, after a court cleared the Boston company of all patent claims brought by Novartis.

pipeline.title: Newly formed Jaguar acquires Afib device assets from J&J
pipeline.summary: Jaguar LAA, a newly formed medtech, has acquired assets that are part of Johnson & Johnson’s AFib device Laminar program for an undisclosed price.

pipeline.title: Olympic skier Lindsey Vonn joins up with Vertex for pain campaign
pipeline.summary: Lindsey Vonn knows more than most about pain. Spending years training as an elite alpine ski racer puts enough pressure on your body, but Vonn’s injuries and her major crash earlier this year that nearly saw her lose her leg put her at a different level.

pipeline.title: Sionna lays off 46% of workforce in strategic shift after cystic fibrosis trial fail
pipeline.summary: Sionna Therapeutics is laying off almost half its workforce as the company recovers from the failure of its closely watched cystic fibrosis add-on program.

pipeline.title: Novo walks away from $285M pact to develop monthly GLP-1 obesity drug with Ascendis
pipeline.summary: Novo’s attempted rebrand got off to a shaky start this week with the news that the pharma had walked away from a $285 million biobucks pact to develop a monthly weight loss drug after less than two years.

pipeline.title: After rejection, FDA approves Telix’s Pixclara, the first FET-PET imaging drug for brain cancer
pipeline.summary: The FDA has signed off on the first-ever glioma drug imaging diagnostic more than a year after it initially rejected the med.

pipeline.title: As ‘cultural weight’ of a psychedelic approval looms, FDA hearing focuses on access and safety
pipeline.summary: As the FDA marches toward the likely first approval of a psychedelic medicine, the agency today convened a hearing seeking public input on how these drugs should be used, monitored and continuously studied in the real world.

pipeline.title: Summit, Akeso look to shed PD-1/VEGF drug doubts with latest study results
pipeline.summary: As dueling data emerge between their drug ivonescimab and a rival Merck medication, Summit and Akeso revealed new findings that impressed Wall Street.

pipeline.title: Lilly cans early experimental obesity drug after ‘high bar’ not met
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly has put the kibosh on an early-stage obesity drug after the candidate didn’t meet the pharma giant’s lofty expectations.

pipeline.title: AstraZeneca’s newly approved pill fails frontline breast cancer study
pipeline.summary: Etcamah is the second oral “SERD” to recently fall short in first-line breast cancer, following a similar setback from Roche earlier this year.

pipeline.title: Shionogi taps The Bloc for omnichannel campaign backing COVID-19 pill Xocova
pipeline.summary: Shionogi is stepping up promotion of COVID-19 drug Xocova, working with The Bloc on an omnichannel campaign designed to encourage people to contact their healthcare professional after being exposed to the virus.

pipeline.title: Cellectis quits CAR-T and pivots to ‘in vivo’ gene editing
pipeline.summary: Long a frontrunner in donor-derived cell therapy research, the French biotech cited a shifting landscape in changing course and choosing to offload its lead programs.

pipeline.title: GSK makes ‘difficult decision’ to shutter German flu vaccine manufacturing site
pipeline.summary: GSK is consolidating two of its influenza vaccine manufacturing sites into one, leaving hundreds of jobs at risk.

pipeline.title: Scholar Rock SMA drug approved by FDA
pipeline.summary: Projected by some analysts as a future blockbuster, Isembyld is the first “muscle-targeted” treatment for the disease and, in clinical testing, helped improve motor function in people on standard therapies.

pipeline.title: No more Nordisk as Novo goes it alone amid rebranding push
pipeline.summary: As Novo Nordisk continues its epic battle with Eli Lilly for market share in the increasingly competitive obesity and diabetes space, Novo is launching a major rebrand of its business, logo and name.

pipeline.title: Cellectis cans allogeneic CAR-Ts to hop aboard in vivo bandwagon
pipeline.summary: Cellectis may have kicked off the year promising “huge momentum” in the allogeneic CAR-T space, but even the French biotech has been unable to resist the dominance of in vivo options.

pipeline.title: Deerfield goes on hiring, promotion spree for ‘Built for This’ growth phase
pipeline.summary: Healthcare marketing and comms agency, Deerfield Group, is creating a new model for growth while making a series of appointments and promotions to help bolster its plans.

pipeline.title: J&J looking to offload orthopedics unit in $20B deal to Apollo: Bloomberg
pipeline.summary: Johnson & Johnson is nearing a $20 billion deal to sell off its unwanted hips-and-knees business, DePuy Synthes, to private equity firm Apollo Equity Management.

pipeline.title: AstraZeneca’s Etcamah flunks first-line breast cancer trial, adding to oral SERDs’ failure record
pipeline.summary: Etcamah now joins Roche’s rival oral SERD, giredestrant, in missing the mark in first-line HR+/HER2- breast cancer, spelling trouble for others’ efforts in the same setting.

pipeline.title: After FDA nod for novel Cabometyx formulation, analysts predict limited threat to Exelixis
pipeline.summary: Following formal sign-off from the FDA, Handa Pharmaceuticals’ branded drug reformulation strategy has paid off for a third time.

pipeline.title: This week in charts: RA’s insatiable appetite, Novartis’ big slide and a reverse merger spree
pipeline.summary: RA Capital has already participated in four biotech financings in September. Meanwhile, Janus Henderson has been the year's most prolific backer of biotech reverse merger deals, according to Gilmartin Group.

pipeline.title: Karyopharm pushes off debt payment; Amgen eyes broader Imdelltra use
pipeline.summary: Karyopharm bought an extra month to negotiate with creditors or pursue a deal. Elsewhere, BridgeBio Pharma’s oncology spinout shook up its development plans and a brain-focused gene therapy startup banked $275 million.

pipeline.title: BioNTech sets survival standard in hard-to-treat cancer ahead of pivotal readout
pipeline.summary: BioNTech has linked gotistobart to a median overall survival of 18.5 months in relapsed lung cancer patients, adding to evidence that the anti-CTLA-4 antibody is better than the standard of care.

pipeline.title: Fierce Pharma Asia—Takeda’s R&D leadership change; Daiichi’s $1.3B court win; New Samsung Bio contract
pipeline.summary: Takeda's long-time R&D chief Andy Plump will retire. Daiichi Sankyo beat back a $1.3 billion damage claim in a lawsuit. Samsung Biologics signed a $262 million contract with an unnamed client. And more.

pipeline.title: mRNA cancer vaccines’ biggest barriers to market
pipeline.summary: Manufacturing hurdles are just one challenge the industry must overcome to commercialize personalized mRNA cancer vaccines.

pipeline.summary: Is the cancer truly gone?

pipeline.title: Why Earlier Commercial Involvement Drives Smarter Strategy
pipeline.summary: Commercial plans can no longer be static. Acumetis' Swathi Rangan explains how teams can adapt strategy as markets evolve.

pipeline.title: Biopharma’s next data advantage may start with genetics
pipeline.summary: Real-world data has become table stakes. The next challenge is connecting it to genetic insight that can sharpen R&D decisions.

pipeline.title: FDA places partial hold on Biohaven’s epilepsy drug
pipeline.summary: Announced mere weeks after Biohaven sold off rights to the therapy, opakalim, the halt affects a study some analysts believe is necessary to support a potential approval.

pipeline.title: How is API Manufacturing Changing?
pipeline.summary: WuXi AppTec’s Ke Chen discusses trends reshaping API manufacturing – while diligence, understanding and controlling the process remains the cornerstone

pipeline.summary: The future of NAMs depends on more than innovation. Learn how sourcing, standards and evidence can accelerate adoption.

pipeline.title: Precision for All: Closing the Gap Between Science and Life

pipeline.summary: Dr. Rana McKay speaks to the ARANOTE trial of NUBEQA® (darolutamide) and what the data mean for patients, doctors, and care providers.

pipeline.title: The Oral GLP-1 Tracker: Novo's Wegovy pill, Lilly's Foundayo continue prescription climb
pipeline.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.

pipeline.title: Fierce Biotech Layoff Tracker 2026: Sionna halves staff; Merck trims more NJ jobs
pipeline.summary: As always, if you know of layoffs occurring at a biotech, please reach out to the Fierce Biotech editorial team.
